person_reference.name: 泉 登翔
person_reference.selection_reason: 固定本文に選手名がないため、本文に登場する30チームから富山を抽選し、その公式現役選手一覧14名から泉登翔を抽選。
person_reference.random_method: Python random.Random('37ef3f4c94ecbcadd399').choice(本文出現順30チーム); random.Random('37ef3f4c94ecbcadd399:player').choice(公式ロスター掲載順14選手)
person_reference.appearance_observed: 中央分けの茶色い髪と暗い根元、耳にかかる長さのサイド、細長い輪郭と角張った顎、直線的な眉、切れ長の目、通った鼻筋、閉じた唇、ひげなし。公式写真をview_imageで確認し、修正時にも容姿参照として使用。写真の貼付けはしていない。
person_reference.depiction: ドリブルする姿の手描きイラスト。特定の実際の試合場面ではない。選手名・背番号・個人成績・出場や活躍の記載なし。チーム・リーグ・スポンサーのロゴなし。

prompt.initial:
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, PNG, landscape 1600 x 900 (16:9), over 1000 pixels wide. Use case: illustration-story / sports article thumbnail.

CONTENT BASIS (locked local article only): 2026-11-14 game results; B.PREMIER and B.ONE have final team scores, but the daily EFF position rankings are NOT available, because official player positions have not yet been confirmed. Do not invent scores, rankings, player statistics or participation. No individual player is named in the article.

ART DIRECTION: approved hand-drawn black-and-lime ink sports poster. Very dark green-black background #151A18, electric lime #CCF43B broad diagonal dry-brush strokes, warm off-white bold Japanese typography, a few restrained ink flecks. High contrast, minimal elements, confident brush and crosshatching, visibly drawn illustration, not photographic, not 3D. Reproduce the spirit of the approved B-culver-black-lime-v3 reference style (bold Japanese headlines, black background, lime brush accents, strongly drawn face), but DO NOT reuse that player's appearance, text, numbers, pose or results.

ONE REAL PERSON: Towa Izumi (泉 登翔), currently on Toyama Grouses' official roster, selected randomly from a team present in the article. Official facial reference actually inspected: https://grouses.jp/roster/players/detail/id=21743?PlayerID=51000464 and its portrait https://bleague.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=2026111214/files/user/roster/696/2026-27/51000464_01.jpg . Closely match these observed traits in illustrated form: young Japanese adult male with medium-length chestnut-brown hair, clear center part, dark roots, thick smoothly swept curtain bangs curving to the sides around the ears, some volume at temple level. Clean-shaven, fairly long narrow oval face and angular jaw, defined chin, straight dark eyebrows, almond-shaped dark eyes looking ahead, straight defined nose, closed lips with a gently defined cupid's bow. Athletic tall lean build. Do not substitute a generic short-haired player or the athlete from the style sample.
Show him in a dynamic low dribbling drive, on the RIGHT approximately half of the frame, with a slight three-quarter view that keeps his facial features recognizable. His torso leans forward, knees flex, one hand naturally controls an orange basketball at hip/thigh level, the other arm balances. Show head, both arms/hands, ball and both knees fully within the frame. Upper legs may finish naturally at the lower illustration boundary. Hands anatomically correct, with five natural fingers and sensible contact with the ball. A clear silhouette and curved dry-brush movement trail suggest motion. Draw his skin in warm ivory and ink shadows, hair dark brown; plain sleeveless uniform in charcoal/off-white with restrained red accent panels. Absolutely NO jersey lettering, NO name, NO number, NO sponsor marks, NO team or league logo. Only one player, no fictional opponents, no crowd faces, no specific arena. This is a general imagined basketball action illustration, not a reconstruction of an actual play or claim he played or excelled on this date.

LAYOUT AND EXACT TEXT:
Keep text area separate from face, limbs and ball. Clear quiet left half with large typography, player occupying right. Ample 5 percent safe margins. Strong thumbnail legibility.
Upper-left small masthead, exact: "バスケまとめ"
Primary enormous lime date: "11/14"
Primary enormous off-white headline directly below, exact: "試合結果"
Below headline, medium off-white text: "当日EFFは掲載待ち"
One smaller but clearly readable qualifier directly underneath: "公式ポジション未確認"
Along bottom in a quiet dark footer, readable and uncut exact labels: "イラスト（AI生成）" and "イメージ"
Render all Japanese text verbatim. No other text. Do not print the real player's name anywhere. Do not include results, points, wins, ranking, player performance claims, TOP3, team names, jersey numbers or logos.
Polished finished single image. No collage, no multiple versions, no reference photos pasted into artwork, no watermarks.
prompt.revision:
Edit Image 1, the basketball thumbnail, with Image 2 as an identity reference ONLY (official portrait of real Toyama Grouses player Towa Izumi / 泉 登翔). Deliver exactly one final PNG around 16:9, 1600x900 or comparable with width above 1000px.

Make this targeted correction to the player artwork: closer likeness to the official portrait and a small safe margin above his hair. Keep the rest of the approved thumbnail intact: the black #151A18 and lime #CCF43B palette, the left text placement and exact Japanese wording, dribbling pose, orange ball, plain logo-free uniform, hand anatomy, visible ink hatching and brush style.
Match the face to the portrait reference: slightly longer/narrower realistic face shape, straighter less exaggerated eyebrows, the actual almond eyes and straight nose, actual closed lips and angular chin; remove the generic anime-like angular eye styling. Keep a hand-drawn ink illustration, not a photo. Hair should be medium-length chestnut brown with dark roots and a center part, swept smoothly to the sides as in the official portrait: reduce the excessive curls/flaring at the ends and bulk, retaining the parted curtain shape. No beard or moustache.
Scale the player artwork down modestly within its right-hand area so ALL hair is visibly below the top frame by at least 35 pixels at 1600px width, leaving hands and ball inside the frame and the face a prominent size. Maintain the dynamic dribbling action and natural knees/lower-leg crop. Do not change the text or cover it.

All existing text must remain exactly and only:
"バスケまとめ"
"11/14"
"試合結果"
"当日EFFは掲載待ち"
"公式ポジション未確認"
"イラスト（AI生成）"
"イメージ"

Do NOT paste the photo, its jersey, logos, sponsor text, number or portrait pose. This is a new imagined action illustration of that real athlete. Do not add names or personal statistics or imply participation in an actual game. No photo realism, no new people, no new text. The reference picture is solely for his facial features/hair, and must not appear in the finished thumbnail.

generator.qa_review: 修正版を表示して目視確認。全文字・日付は意図どおりで、当日EFF掲載待ちと公式ポジション未確認の留保を保持。公式写真の髪型・輪郭・眉・目鼻・口元と照合しイラストとして確認。頭頂部に余白あり。顔・両手・ボールの見切れなし、指と腕のつながりを確認、脚の下端は意図的なフレーミング。文字と人物の重なりなし。イラスト（AI生成）およびイメージの表記が読める。
